versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g If the <LdComUser_LdComCbkRxIndication> notification callback is configured in the LdCom High Proxy (via the LdComUser- CallbackName (See [ECUC_LdCom_00023]) parameter, where the LdComUser- CallbackType (See [ECUC_LdCom_00025]) is set to LDCOM_RX_INDICATION ), all the configured <LdComUser_LdComCbkRxIndication> callbacks shall be invoked, when the associated instance of the SwCluC_LdComProxy_LdComCbkRxIndica- tion from the LdCom Low Proxy is called.
